identity.evidence: Bald faceless white-grey anatomy-v3 athlete, smooth neutral pelvic centre and white trainers remain consistent in all three native poses.

camera.evidence: Fixed three-quarter camera, native 1536x1024 canvas and framing. Two tower anchors and widths pass unrounded one-pixel/one-percent checks.

anatomy.evidence: Three native poses inspected: continuous arms, natural elbow extension and intact hands; no extra limbs. New midpoint has clearly bent elbows between start and finish. Near-arm foreshortening remains illustrative.

equipment.evidence: Both levers remain attached to the same overhead pivots and horizontal grips. Tower, seat and support remain stable. Visible lever projection varies through rotation; this is qualitative visual review, not calibrated 3D rigidity verification.

contact.evidence: Both hands wrap the same grips throughout. Head/torso, hips and feet remain supported by back pad, seat and floor respectively; no visible grip separation.

physics.evidence: Forward/upward handle arc accompanies elbow extension around stable overhead pivots; controlled reversal reuses the intermediate and start poses. Enclosed stack and transmission are not visible, so routing ratio and selected-stack lift cannot be verified. No visible contradictory motion was found; approval concerns the illustrated external press movement.

muscles.evidence: Pectorals remain strongest purple; shoulder and upper-arm secondary highlights lighter lilac. Forearms remain white-grey. Colours indicate qualitative emphasis, not measured activation.

cueAgreement.evidence: Six cues match supported setup, forward press, extension, hold, controlled return and reset. The stack-control cue is an instruction, not a claim that the concealed plates are visible. Every cue has at most seven words.

sequenceAndLoop.evidence: Refined frames reviewed in real ExerciseFormFrames for all six beats and 6-to-1. Near grip now progresses approximately x690 to x730 to x770; not a claim of exact joint interpolation. Intentional reuse 4=3,5=2,6=1.

mobileLight.evidence: Refined sequence reviewed at 390x844 in actual light theme with repository CSS/fonts; all beats and loop checked and all three unique poses visually inspected. Readable captions, loaded native image and no horizontal overflow.

mobileDark.evidence: Same real-player checks in dark theme at 390x844, including changed frames 2/5 and return loop. Captions readable and no clipping or missing image observed.
